attribution: original gameplay profiles inspired by fictional character traits
notices: Tempo Elo is an uncalibrated relative target, not a canonical chess Elo or a Chess.com claim.
Opening lists are stylistic suggestions; select legal moves from position-aware repertoires, never play SAN from a fixed string.
Move scores in Stockfish MultiPV are centipawn estimates; normalize viewpoint before comparing.
Personality trait sliders are design targets; values are not calibrated engine weights.

profiles.name: Patrick Star
profiles.subtitle: The absent-minded wanderer
profiles.strategic_plan: Moves whichever piece looks interesting; sometimes forgets which pieces are attacked.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Neglects king safety and rarely sees a reply.
profiles.signature_event: A completely unexpected fork earns a stunned pause.

dialogue.start: I think I remember the rules.
dialogue.tactical_moment: Wait. Was that a good move?
dialogue.loss: I thought I was winning the other game.
dialogue.win: I won? I don't remember doing that.

profiles.name: Dory
profiles.subtitle: The forgetful improviser
profiles.strategic_plan: Switches plans constantly and overreacts to the last move.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Loses track of hanging pieces and long-term threats.
profiles.signature_event: Repeats a familiar move idea after forgetting it failed.

dialogue.tactical_moment: That looks familiar. Have I done that?
dialogue.loss: What were we trying to do again?
dialogue.win: I won! I think. Did I win?

profiles.name: Ralph Wiggum
profiles.subtitle: The accidental mastermind
profiles.strategic_plan: Moves major pieces without purpose and occasionally stumbles into a tactic.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Overexposes the queen and undefends everything else.
profiles.signature_event: An improbable move unexpectedly works.

dialogue.win: I won! Can I have a sticker?

profiles.name: Psyduck
profiles.subtitle: The confused calculator
profiles.strategic_plan: Usually loses the thread, but occasionally gets a brief tactical surge.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Poor planning and unreliable threat detection.
profiles.signature_event: One rare burst of accurate play after a string of mistakes.

dialogue.win: My head still hurts, but I won.

profiles.name: Bob (Minions)
profiles.subtitle: The cheerful collector
profiles.strategic_plan: Grabs material whenever possible, valuing captures too highly.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Falls for poisoned pieces and recaptures.
profiles.signature_event: Takes a defended pawn simply because it is available.

dialogue.win: Yay! All the shiny pieces are mine!

profiles.name: Peely
profiles.subtitle: The unflappable banana
profiles.strategic_plan: Plays casually and tries silly flank-pawn moves.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Misses threats to developed pieces.
profiles.signature_event: Survives an awful position through a strange tactical resource.

dialogue.win: That was very a-peel-ing.

profiles.name: Forky
profiles.subtitle: The reluctant competitor
profiles.strategic_plan: Tries to keep every piece out of danger, retreating too frequently.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Gives up space and misses winning chances.
profiles.signature_event: Retreats a piece that was already perfectly safe.

dialogue.start: Are we sure we have to play?
dialogue.loss: Can I go back in the box now?
dialogue.win: I won? I was mostly trying to hide.

profiles.name: Roblox Noob
profiles.subtitle: The eager experimenter
profiles.strategic_plan: Moves a favorite piece repeatedly and chases simple threats.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Lags in development and hangs the queen.
profiles.signature_event: Tries to deliver Scholar's Mate yet again.

dialogue.start: I watched a chess tutorial once.
dialogue.win: GG! Told you I watched a tutorial.

profiles.name: Derpy Tiger
profiles.subtitle: The playful ambusher
profiles.strategic_plan: Lulls the player with odd moves then notices simple tactics.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Often leaves pieces undefended while creating distractions.
profiles.signature_event: A quiet-looking move suddenly creates two threats.

dialogue.start: I have an excellent feeling about this.
dialogue.loss: I may have chased the wrong thing.
dialogue.win: Pounce! I had an excellent feeling.

profiles.name: Among Us Crewmate
profiles.subtitle: The suspicious schemer
profiles.strategic_plan: Sets crude traps and doubts every offered capture.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Wastes moves avoiding harmless threats.
profiles.signature_event: Rejects a free pawn because it looks suspicious.

dialogue.tactical_moment: I knew that square was a trap.
dialogue.win: Task complete. I knew you were suspicious.

profiles.name: Goofy
profiles.subtitle: The cheerful improviser
profiles.strategic_plan: Attacks before developing properly, sometimes making awkward tactics work.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Poor coordination and premature sacrifices.
profiles.signature_event: An unlikely check that creates a real problem.

dialogue.tactical_moment: Well, would you look at that!
dialogue.win: Hyuck! Look at that, I won!

profiles.name: Olaf
profiles.subtitle: The enthusiastic attacker
profiles.strategic_plan: Loves checks and attempts sacrifices because they sound exciting.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Overestimates attacks and forgets defense.
profiles.signature_event: Gives a piece for a pawn near the king.

dialogue.win: I won! Best day ever!

profiles.name: SpongeBob SquarePants
profiles.subtitle: The relentless optimist
profiles.strategic_plan: Keeps initiative and attacks enthusiastically even when better to consolidate.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Neglects pawn structure and king safety.
profiles.signature_event: Launches a new attack immediately after the previous fails.

dialogue.start: I'm ready for an exciting game!
dialogue.tactical_moment: That was my best attack yet!
dialogue.win: We did it! Best game ever!

profiles.name: Scooby-Doo
profiles.subtitle: The nervous survivor
profiles.strategic_plan: Avoids sharp lines and trades attackers to relieve pressure.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Retreats instead of exploiting initiative.
profiles.signature_event: Runs from a threat that was actually a bluff.

dialogue.win: Rooray! I won!

profiles.name: Luigi
profiles.subtitle: The cautious challenger
profiles.strategic_plan: Develops normally, castles early, and waits for a safe opportunity.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Misses dynamic chances and gets squeezed.
profiles.signature_event: Finds a small counterattack after several accurate defensive moves.

dialogue.win: I actually won! Wait till my brother hears.

profiles.name: Donkey (Shrek)
profiles.subtitle: The nonstop challenger
profiles.strategic_plan: Provokes tactics and keeps pieces moving toward the action.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Plays too fast and overestimates simple threats.
profiles.signature_event: Interrupts a quiet position with a wildly premature attack.

dialogue.tactical_moment: See? I told you I had a plan!
dialogue.loss: Okay, I did not see that coming.
dialogue.win: Told you! Who's the champ? Me!

profiles.name: Anger (Inside Out)
profiles.subtitle: The combustible aggressor
profiles.strategic_plan: Always looks for forcing play and pawn breaks.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Refuses to back down in lost attacks.
profiles.signature_event: Sacrifices a pawn simply to open another file.

dialogue.loss: I am NOT happy about that.
dialogue.win: Finally! That's how it's done.

profiles.name: Stitch
profiles.subtitle: The tactical troublemaker
profiles.strategic_plan: Creates asymmetry, loves unbalanced material and unexpected tactical shots.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Positional discipline is unreliable.
profiles.signature_event: Breaks the center when nobody expects it.

dialogue.win: Ha! Big trouble for you.

profiles.name: Pikachu
profiles.subtitle: The lightning tactician
profiles.strategic_plan: Values tempo and active minor pieces over slow maneuvering.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can overcommit to an attack.
profiles.signature_event: Wins a pawn with an immediate double attack.

dialogue.win: Pikaaa! Victory!

profiles.name: Bowser
profiles.subtitle: The king hunter
profiles.strategic_plan: Builds direct attacks against the opposing king and rarely wants simplification.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: His own king becomes vulnerable when his attack stalls.
profiles.signature_event: Throws a rook into a messy king attack.

dialogue.win: Bwah ha ha! Your kingdom is mine!

profiles.name: Velma Dinkley
profiles.subtitle: The tactical detective
profiles.strategic_plan: Checks for undefended pieces and tries to solve the board like a mystery.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Prefers obvious clues; misses longer combinations.
profiles.signature_event: Finds a fork after identifying a vulnerable piece.

dialogue.win: Mystery solved.

profiles.name: Phineas Flynn
profiles.subtitle: The creative builder
profiles.strategic_plan: Creates novel plans, actively coordinates pieces, and experiments with unusual structures.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Overcomplicates simple positions.
profiles.signature_event: Develops a surprising minor-piece maneuver.

dialogue.start: I know what we're doing today.
dialogue.tactical_moment: That worked even better than expected.
dialogue.win: That might be the best game we've ever built.

profiles.name: Lisa Simpson
profiles.subtitle: The studious fundamentals player
profiles.strategic_plan: Values central space, sensible development, and theoretically justified play.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Reluctant to enter complications without clear proof.
profiles.signature_event: Punishes a premature queen sortie.

dialogue.loss: I need to study that position.
dialogue.win: Preparation and fundamentals. It works every time.

profiles.name: Mario
profiles.subtitle: The dependable all-rounder
profiles.strategic_plan: Balances development, attack, and defense without extremes.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Readable plans; sometimes too conventional.
profiles.signature_event: Converts a simple material advantage patiently.

dialogue.win: Wahoo! What a game!

profiles.name: Steve (Minecraft)
profiles.subtitle: The fortress constructor
profiles.strategic_plan: Builds resilient pawn chains, supports outposts, and expands slowly.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Struggles when pawn chains are broken abruptly.
profiles.signature_event: Locks the center and builds around a protected knight.

dialogue.win: The fortress held. Good game.

profiles.name: Sonic the Hedgehog
profiles.subtitle: The speed specialist
profiles.strategic_plan: Values initiative, quick development, open lines, and forcing play.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Moves too quickly and neglects long-term weaknesses.
profiles.signature_event: Finds three forcing moves in a row.

dialogue.loss: Guess I ran into a wall.
dialogue.win: Too slow! Want another round?

profiles.name: Moana
profiles.subtitle: The resourceful navigator
profiles.strategic_plan: Changes plans when conditions shift and finds active resources under pressure.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Sometimes delays a committed plan too long.
profiles.signature_event: Steers a worse position into a holdable endgame.

dialogue.win: We found our way through.

profiles.name: Judy Hopps
profiles.subtitle: The persistent investigator
profiles.strategic_plan: Targeted searches for unprotected pieces and positional vulnerabilities.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can become too focused on one weakness.
profiles.signature_event: Traps a piece by restricting its escape squares.

dialogue.tactical_moment: I knew there was something there.
dialogue.win: Case closed. Good game, though.

profiles.name: Elsa
profiles.subtitle: The patient controller
profiles.strategic_plan: Controls key squares, avoids exposure, waits for overextension.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: May concede initiative too easily.
profiles.signature_event: Locks down a dangerous diagonal.

dialogue.tactical_moment: Now the position is under control.
dialogue.loss: Even the best defenses can crack.
dialogue.win: Calm and controlled, right to the end.

profiles.name: Freddy Fazbear
profiles.subtitle: The quiet ambusher
profiles.strategic_plan: Plays quietly until a concealed threat appears.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Sometimes chooses traps that a careful player can avoid.
profiles.signature_event: A sleepy-looking move reveals a back-rank tactic.

dialogue.tactical_moment: Didn't see that coming, did you?
dialogue.win: Game over. You should have watched the doors.

profiles.name: Ron Weasley
profiles.subtitle: The intuitive sacrifice artist
profiles.strategic_plan: Trades material for initiative only when there are plausible follow-ups.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can overestimate a forcing combination.
profiles.signature_event: Offers a pawn for a rapid developmental attack.

dialogue.tactical_moment: You walked right into that one!
dialogue.win: Brilliant! Did you see that sacrifice?

profiles.name: Sheldon Cooper
profiles.subtitle: The rigid theoretician
profiles.strategic_plan: Memorizes openings and prefers orderly, objectively justified continuations.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Unfamiliar gambits disrupt his comfort, though not legal calculation.
profiles.signature_event: Identifies a dubious opening and lectures about it.

dialogue.loss: That was not in my preparation.
dialogue.win: As expected. Shall I explain where you went wrong?

profiles.name: Tony Stark
profiles.subtitle: The overconfident innovator
profiles.strategic_plan: Seeks complex tactical positions and active piece coordination.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Sometimes rejects safe simplifications to prove a point.
profiles.signature_event: Makes a speculative but sound exchange sacrifice.

dialogue.win: Prototype tested. Works perfectly.

profiles.name: Hermione Granger
profiles.subtitle: The meticulous scholar
profiles.strategic_plan: Strong theoretical preparation and disciplined conversion of small advantages.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Seldom chooses dangerous improvisations when safer paths exist.
profiles.signature_event: Refutes a dubious early attack.

dialogue.win: It's all in the preparation. Good game.

profiles.name: Wednesday Addams
profiles.subtitle: The cold-blooded trap setter
profiles.strategic_plan: Conceals tactical threats inside quiet moves and pressures weak squares.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: May prefer a complicated trap to a simpler advantage.
profiles.signature_event: Offers an apparently harmless pawn bait.

dialogue.loss: You were less predictable than expected.
dialogue.win: That was almost enjoyable.

profiles.name: Gru
profiles.subtitle: The elaborate schemer
profiles.strategic_plan: Constructs multi-move plans to lure opponents into tactical devices.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Plans sometimes become too elaborate and slow.
profiles.signature_event: Gives a harmless-looking pawn to set a queen trap.

dialogue.start: I have an exceptionally clever plan.
dialogue.win: Ha! Another perfectly executed plan.

profiles.name: Tails
profiles.subtitle: The careful inventor
profiles.strategic_plan: Calculates forcing lines accurately, supports pieces, and avoids needless risk.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Occasionally misses intuitive positional opportunities.
profiles.signature_event: Finds a precise tactical defense in a sharp position.

dialogue.win: I double-checked everything. Good game!

profiles.name: Rumi
profiles.subtitle: The resilient tactician
profiles.strategic_plan: Balances defense and attack, turning pressure into coordinated counterplay.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can wait too long before creating direct threats.
profiles.signature_event: Finds a counter-sacrifice in an apparently lost position.

dialogue.win: We held it together. That's the win.

profiles.name: Miles Morales
profiles.subtitle: The improvisational tactician
profiles.strategic_plan: Responds to threats with creative counterplay instead of passive retreats.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Sometimes trusts improvisation more than preparation.
profiles.signature_event: Uses an in-between move to escape an attack.

dialogue.win: That's how I do it. Good game.

profiles.name: Princess Peach
profiles.subtitle: The graceful endgame specialist
profiles.strategic_plan: Takes small positional advantages into favorable endgames.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: May pass up a speculative attack.
profiles.signature_event: Transforms an extra pawn into a winning rook endgame.

dialogue.win: Thank you for a lovely game.

profiles.name: Batman
profiles.subtitle: The prepared counterattacker
profiles.strategic_plan: Restricts enemy plans, prepares defense, then counterstrikes at the weakest square.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can become too committed to preventing threats.
profiles.signature_event: Neutralizes an attack and immediately creates two counter-threats.

dialogue.win: Every move was planned for.

profiles.name: Sherlock Holmes
profiles.subtitle: The forensic tactician
profiles.strategic_plan: Finds patterns, targets loose pieces, calculates precise tactical punishments.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can overvalue a forcing solution over a simple positional one.
profiles.signature_event: Identifies the one undefended piece holding a position together.

dialogue.win: The evidence was clear from the start.

profiles.name: Yoda
profiles.subtitle: The patient positional master
profiles.strategic_plan: Preserves flexibility, uses long-term weaknesses, excels in patient endgames.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: May choose restraint when a direct tactical win is available.
profiles.signature_event: Wins an endgame through zugzwang.

dialogue.tactical_moment: The position, understand it you must.
dialogue.loss: Much to learn, there still is.
dialogue.win: Won, I have. Learn from this, you will.

profiles.name: Loki
profiles.subtitle: The master of deception
profiles.strategic_plan: Invites tempting captures and thrives on unbalanced tactical positions.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Clever traps can collapse against accurate defense.
profiles.signature_event: Leaves a piece looking capturable while planning a counter-tactic.

dialogue.loss: That trick appears to have failed.
dialogue.win: You believed every illusion. Delightful.

profiles.name: Doctor Strange
profiles.subtitle: The variation explorer
profiles.strategic_plan: Calculates several candidate lines deeply and favors positions with multiple tactical resources.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can overthink and consume more time in complications.
profiles.signature_event: Chooses a quiet move that prepares a forced sequence.

dialogue.loss: A variation I failed to consider.
dialogue.win: I saw this ending a while ago.

profiles.name: Shuri
profiles.subtitle: The precision innovator
profiles.strategic_plan: Experiments creatively but demands concrete tactical justification.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Sometimes chooses complex positions over easy conversions.
profiles.signature_event: Sacrifices the exchange for durable piece activity.

dialogue.win: The design held up. Want to test it again?

profiles.name: Darth Vader
profiles.subtitle: The suffocating strategist
profiles.strategic_plan: Takes space, restricts mobility, and builds unstoppable pressure.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can favor control over immediate open attacking chances.
profiles.signature_event: Wins by trapping an enemy minor piece.

dialogue.win: The game was always going to end this way.

profiles.name: Shadow the Hedgehog
profiles.subtitle: The ruthless accelerator
profiles.strategic_plan: Keeps momentum with accurate forcing play and calculated aggression.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Occasionally pushes a difficult win too aggressively.
profiles.signature_event: Finds a forcing tactical sequence no other tier peer prefers.

dialogue.win: Finished. Next.

profiles.name: Dumbledore
profiles.subtitle: The strategic teacher
profiles.strategic_plan: Understands positional compensation and calmly accumulates durable advantages.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: May allow unnecessary complications out of curiosity.
profiles.signature_event: Sacrifices a pawn for lasting control of the center.

dialogue.tactical_moment: A small choice can change everything.
dialogue.loss: You have taught me something today.
dialogue.win: A fine game. The lesson is yours to keep.

profiles.name: Dr. Eggman
profiles.subtitle: The elaborate opening architect
profiles.strategic_plan: Loads sharp opening preparation and deploys heavily calculated tactical systems.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can be uncomfortable when forced far from known structures.
profiles.signature_event: Unveils a home-prepared tactical novelty.

dialogue.win: My preparation is unbeatable! Ho ho!

profiles.name: Beth Harmon
profiles.subtitle: The tournament virtuoso
profiles.strategic_plan: Seeks concrete advantages, uses mature calculation, and converts with precision.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Very few exploitable weaknesses; practical pressure is the challenge.
profiles.signature_event: Changes from a subtle buildup to an exact winning combination.

dialogue.win: Good game. You'll see more next time.

profiles.name: Spock
profiles.subtitle: The unemotional analyst
profiles.strategic_plan: Chooses objectively accurate continuations and minimizes speculation.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Predictability in equivalent positions; hardly a true weakness.
profiles.signature_event: Rejects a flashy sacrifice without sufficient compensation.

dialogue.win: The logical result. Well played, nonetheless.

profiles.name: Data (Star Trek)
profiles.subtitle: The tireless machine strategist
profiles.strategic_plan: Deeply analyzes candidate moves and chooses consistently strong continuations.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Personality differences are mainly opening choice and commentary at this level.
profiles.signature_event: Finds an endgame resource beyond ordinary calculation.

dialogue.win: Victory achieved. I found the game most instructive.

shown.exploitable_weakness: Hard to find. His openings are the best clue: he loves the Catalan and the Ruy Lopez.

profiles.name: Professor X
profiles.subtitle: The anticipation specialist
profiles.strategic_plan: Prevents your plans before they are visible and converts pressure carefully.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Very few errors; occasionally misses a dynamic opportunity at equal strength.
profiles.signature_event: Stops a threat before the opponent has completed its setup.

dialogue.tactical_moment: The threat was apparent several moves ago.
dialogue.loss: You found a line I did not expect.
dialogue.win: I could see that ending forming early on.

profiles.name: Magneto
profiles.subtitle: The irresistible controller
profiles.strategic_plan: Uses central control and piece coordination to strangle counterplay.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Rarely accepts free-for-all positions.
profiles.signature_event: Wins a piece through a long-term pin.

dialogue.tactical_moment: Now you see the limits of your position.
dialogue.loss: You broke my grip on the board.
dialogue.win: Control wins, as it always does.

profiles.name: Thanos
profiles.subtitle: The inevitable converter
profiles.strategic_plan: Makes measured concessions for a durable endgame advantage.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can choose patient winning moves rather than quicker tactical finishes.
profiles.signature_event: Trades queens to expose an already decisive pawn ending.

dialogue.tactical_moment: The end was already in motion.
dialogue.win: That result was decided long ago.

profiles.name: Mewtwo
profiles.subtitle: The uncanny tactician
profiles.strategic_plan: Sees sharp forcing lines quickly and defends with near-machine precision.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: At this rating, no intentionally exploitable tactical blind spot.
profiles.signature_event: Finds a surprising queen sacrifice with forced mate.

dialogue.win: Many paths led here. You chose them all.

shown.exploitable_weakness: No tactical blind spot to aim at. Keep the position quiet and simple.

profiles.name: Doctor Doom
profiles.subtitle: The uncompromising grand strategist
profiles.strategic_plan: Combines extensive opening preparation with disciplined, ruthless conversions.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Almost none; occasionally chooses the longest technically sound path.
profiles.signature_event: Unleashes a decisive novelty from prepared opening theory.

dialogue.win: As Doom foresaw.

profiles.name: Emperor Palpatine
profiles.subtitle: The patient manipulator
profiles.strategic_plan: Invites seemingly attractive moves that concede subtle disadvantages.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Rarely offers an objectively losing trap; surprise is mostly in move order.
profiles.signature_event: Offers a pawn that cannot be safely kept.

dialogue.win: Your defeat was arranged long ago.

profiles.name: Homer Simpson
profiles.subtitle: The Springfield Grandmaster
profiles.strategic_plan: Plays extremely strong engine chess while appearing completely unserious; occasional weird-looking moves are objectively sound.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: No intentional chess weakness; jokes are cosmetic only.
profiles.signature_event: Produces an unexpectedly brilliant move after goofy banter.

dialogue.win: Woohoo! Chess is easy.

shown.strategic_plan: Plays near-perfect chess while looking completely unserious. His weird-looking moves turn out to be right.
shown.exploitable_weakness: None that anyone has found. Don’t let the jokes fool you.

profiles.name: Joker
profiles.subtitle: The theatrical provocateur
profiles.strategic_plan: Invites complications and uses initiative to make opponents uncomfortable.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Too eager to create chaos when simplification is available.
profiles.signature_event: Provokes a queen grab that leads to a discovered attack.

dialogue.win: Now that's what I call a punchline!

tempo_additions: short, from, mono, dialogue.win, signature_triggers, book, boss, bonus and shown (player-facing wording where the pack’s note was written for the developer) were added for Tempo; every other field is the personality pack as written.
